changes.before: a person given to fanciful speculations and enthusiasms with little regard for what is actually possible
changes.after: Able to imagine better ways of doing things in the future; also, a person with this ability.
changes.reason: 原英文强调不顾现实的幻想者，负面含义与两句有远见、看出潜力的褒义不符。

contexts.text: Her visionary approach changed the way we ran the business.
contexts.translation: 她富有远见的做法改变了我们经营企业的方式。

contexts.text: He was a visionary who saw the potential of the empty factory.
contexts.translation: 他很有远见，看出了那座闲置工厂的潜力。

changes.before: n two items of the same kind
changes.after: Two people who work or perform together, especially musicians or entertainers.
changes.reason: 原英文两个同类物件过于泛化，两例明确是喜剧和爵士表演搭档；用二人合作表演的核心性质。

contexts.text: The comedy duo had the whole audience laughing.
contexts.translation: 这对喜剧搭档逗得全场观众大笑。

contexts.text: We hired a jazz duo to play at the party.
contexts.translation: 我们请了一个爵士乐二人组在派对上演奏。

changes.before: a group of genetically identical cells or organisms derived from a single cell or individual by some kind of asexual reproduction
changes.after: An identical copy, whether of an organism, an object, or digital data; also, to make such a copy.
changes.reason: 原英文限定遗传相同的生物细胞群，两句为硬盘复制及手机仿制品，不能只用生物群体定义。

contexts.text: I need to clone this drive before replacing it.
contexts.translation: 我得先完整复制这个硬盘，再换掉它。

contexts.text: This phone looks like a cheap clone of the original.
contexts.translation: 这部手机看起来是原版的廉价仿制品。

changes.before: the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers
changes.after: To stop oneself from doing something; also, a line or section repeated in a song.
changes.reason: 原英文限定独唱者由众人加入，不是副歌的一般定义，且例1为克制不做某事；改核心两义。

contexts.text: Please refrain from talking during the performance.
contexts.translation: 演出期间请不要说话。

contexts.text: I kept humming the refrain long after the song ended.
contexts.translation: 歌曲结束很久以后，我还在哼它的副歌。

changes.before: still full
changes.after: Not used, eaten, altered, or disturbed.
changes.reason: 原英文仍然满的不能准确解释未吃过三明治或多年原样的房间；未动过不等于满。

contexts.text: Her sandwich was still untouched when I came back.
contexts.translation: 我回来时，她的三明治还一口没动。

contexts.text: The room has been untouched for years.
contexts.translation: 这个房间多年来一直保持原样。

changes.before: expend profusely; also used with abstract nouns
changes.after: Very generous, abundant, or luxurious; as a verb, to give something in large amounts.
changes.reason: 原英文为大量花费的动词，两句用作豪华的形容词；改性质量词并保留zh大量给予义。

contexts.text: They threw a lavish party for their anniversary.
contexts.translation: 他们为周年纪念办了一场豪华派对。

contexts.text: I don't need a lavish gift; a card would be lovely.
contexts.translation: 我不需要贵重的礼物，一张贺卡就很好。

changes.before: someone who journeys in foreign lands
changes.after: A person who travels to a sacred place for religious reasons.
changes.reason: 原英文仅在外国旅行，遗漏朝圣的宗教目的，易误选普通旅行者。

contexts.text: The pilgrim carried only a small bag on the journey.
contexts.translation: 那名朝圣者旅途中只带了一个小包。

contexts.text: We met a pilgrim walking toward the shrine.
contexts.translation: 我们遇到了一名步行前往圣地的朝圣者。

source.support: 完整词条确认宗教目的前往圣地，区别一般海外旅行。

changes.before: stone post at side of a road to show distances
changes.after: An important stage in progress, or a roadside marker showing distance.
changes.reason: 原英文只物理路边里程碑，两句是人生及项目重要节点，兼顾原路标义但避免把节点说成石柱。

contexts.text: Finishing my first novel was a personal milestone.
contexts.translation: 完成第一本小说是我人生中的一个重要节点。

contexts.text: The team celebrated a milestone in the project.
contexts.translation: 团队庆祝了项目中的一个里程碑。

changes.before: a favorite saying of a sect or political group
changes.after: A short saying that expresses a person's or group's guiding belief.
changes.reason: 原英文只教派或政治团体的喜好说法，家庭座右铭和个人格言不必属于这些团体。

contexts.text: Our family's motto is to finish what we start.
contexts.translation: 我们家的座右铭是做事有始有终。

contexts.text: She wrote her favorite motto above her desk.
contexts.translation: 她把最喜欢的座右铭写在了书桌上方。

changes.before: n Englishman and husband of Elizabeth II (born 1921)
changes.after: A Dutch technology company and brand known for healthcare equipment and electric shavers.
changes.reason: 原英文错指伊丽莎白二世丈夫；当前zh及两句均为家电品牌，按官方资料写公司及品牌性质。

contexts.text: I bought a Philips kettle for the office kitchen.
contexts.translation: 我给办公室厨房买了一个飞利浦电水壶。

contexts.text: Where is the instruction manual for this Philips shaver?
contexts.translation: 这款飞利浦剃须刀的说明书在哪儿？

source.support: 官方公司页确认健康科技公司及品牌授权关系。
官方历史页确认1891年在荷兰创立。

changes.before: of or relating to a phenomenon
changes.after: Extremely good, impressive, or successful.
changes.reason: 原英文是有关现象的技术性形容词，两句均用作极好、非凡的评价，核心褒义错配。

contexts.text: Your homemade bread tastes phenomenal.
contexts.translation: 你自制的面包味道棒极了。

contexts.text: The band had phenomenal success with its first album.
contexts.translation: 这个乐队的第一张专辑大获成功。

changes.before: British colonial financier and statesman in South Africa; made a fortune in gold and diamond mining; helped colonize the territory now known as Zimbabwe; he endowed annual fellowships for British Commonwealth and United States students to study at Oxford University (1853-1902)
changes.after: A Greek island in the Dodecanese, known for its medieval town.
changes.reason: 原英文为南部非洲殖民政治人物，两句旅行和明信片均明确指岛屿；官方旅游资料支持岛名。

contexts.text: We spent a week on Rhodes last summer.
contexts.translation: 去年夏天我们在罗得岛住了一周。

contexts.text: My friend sent me a postcard from Rhodes.
contexts.translation: 朋友从罗得岛给我寄了一张明信片。

source.support: 希腊官方旅游页确认Dodecanese岛屿，非同姓政治人物。

changes.before: United States editor (1920-1993)
changes.reason: 原英文锁定1920–1993年美国编辑，当前只有姓氏和普通课堂、留言场景，无法确认同一人；退回中文性质题。

contexts.text: Mr. Howe will be teaching the evening class.
contexts.translation: 豪先生将负责教晚上的课。

contexts.text: I left a message for Howe at the front desk.
contexts.translation: 我在前台给豪留了言。

changes.before: play in which children pretend to put out a fire
changes.after: A man whose job is to put out fires and rescue people.
changes.reason: 原英文为儿童扮演灭火的游戏，两句是消防职业人员，明确传统男性称呼。

contexts.text: A fireman helped the family out of the building.
contexts.translation: 一名消防员帮助那家人离开了大楼。

contexts.text: My grandfather worked as a fireman for thirty years.
contexts.translation: 我爷爷当了三十年消防员。

changes.before: (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
changes.after: A major, sudden change that causes disruption or confusion.
changes.reason: 原英文地质抬升，当前两句是移居和公司动荡，不是地质运动。

contexts.text: Moving abroad caused a lot of upheaval in our lives.
contexts.translation: 移居国外给我们的生活带来了很大的变动。

contexts.text: The company went through a period of upheaval.
contexts.translation: 公司经历了一段动荡时期。

changes.before: (chemistry) a reaction in which an elementary substance displaces and sets free a constituent element from a compound
changes.after: Movement away from an original position or home, including forced relocation.
changes.reason: 原英文化学置换反应，两句是洪灾迁移和物体位移，核心义完全不同。

contexts.text: The report describes the displacement of families by the flood.
contexts.translation: 报告描述了洪水导致多户人家流离失所的情况。

contexts.text: The diagram shows the displacement of the object from its starting point.
contexts.translation: 图中展示了物体相对起点的位移。

changes.before: a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers)
changes.after: A long, often difficult journey on foot.
changes.reason: 原英文限定牛车移民旅行，两句为山地徒步和很长的步行路程。

contexts.text: We planned a three-day trek through the hills.
contexts.translation: 我们计划在山间徒步三天。

contexts.text: It's quite a trek from the station to your house.
contexts.translation: 从车站到你家还真要走挺远。

changes.before: v kill in large numbers
changes.after: To remove or eliminate something completely.
changes.reason: 原英文仅大量杀死，没有彻底消除的关键，不能解释根除欺凌。

contexts.text: The school hopes to eradicate bullying.
contexts.translation: 学校希望彻底杜绝欺凌。

contexts.text: It's difficult to eradicate weeds from this garden.
contexts.translation: 这个花园里的杂草很难彻底清除。

source.support: 官方词条支持完全消除，而非仅大量杀死。

changes.before: the material removed by a cut made underneath
changes.after: To offer a lower price than a competitor, or weaken someone's position or confidence.
changes.reason: 原英文在下面切掉的材料名词，两句均动词，分别价格竞争和削弱信心。

contexts.text: The rival shop tried to undercut our prices.
contexts.translation: 竞争对手的店试图以比我们更低的价格销售。

contexts.text: Those comments could undercut confidence in the team.
contexts.translation: 那些评论可能削弱人们对团队的信心。

changes.before: taking exception; especially a quibble based on a captious argument
changes.after: Words placed with a picture to explain it, or text showing speech on a screen.
changes.reason: 原英文挑剔性异议，和图片说明、字幕毫不相干，改简短说明文本性质。

contexts.text: The caption under the photo gives the date and location.
contexts.translation: 照片下的说明标明了日期和地点。

contexts.text: Help me write a funny caption for this picture.
contexts.translation: 帮我给这张照片写一句有趣的说明吧。

changes.before: United States filmmaker who with his brothers founded the movie studio that produced the first talking picture (1881-1958)
changes.reason: 原英文为某位华纳制片人，两句是无身份信息的姓氏，包括Ms. Warner，不能把普通姓名绑定历史人物。

contexts.text: Warner volunteered to organize the next meeting.
contexts.translation: 沃纳自愿负责组织下一次会议。

contexts.text: I borrowed the book from Ms. Warner.
contexts.translation: 我从沃纳女士那里借了这本书。

changes.before: n a pair of loose trousers tied by a drawstring around the waist; worn by men and women in some Asian countries
changes.after: Loose clothes worn for sleeping, usually a matching top and trousers.
changes.reason: 原英文仅亚洲穿着的抽绳裤，两句是现代睡衣套装，睡眠用途是识别核心。

contexts.text: These pyjamas are so soft.
contexts.translation: 这套睡衣真软。

contexts.text: I left my pyjamas in the hotel room.
contexts.translation: 我把睡衣落在酒店房间了。

changes.before: United States composer (1910-1981)
changes.after: A person whose job is to cut hair, especially men's hair, and sometimes shave beards.
changes.reason: 原英文为美国作曲家，两句是为顾客理发的职业人员。

contexts.text: My barber knows exactly how I like my hair.
contexts.translation: 我的理发师很清楚我喜欢什么发型。

contexts.text: There's a barber near the station.
contexts.translation: 车站附近有个理发师。

changes.before: limit in quality or quantity
changes.after: Very little, or less than is needed.
changes.reason: 原英文是限制数量质量的动词，两句是修饰证据和注意力的形容词。

contexts.text: There was scant evidence to support the claim.
contexts.translation: 支持这个说法的证据很少。

contexts.text: She paid scant attention to the instructions.
contexts.translation: 她几乎没注意那些说明。

changes.before: an unsteady uneven gait
changes.after: A sudden, unsteady movement; in an idiom, to leave someone without needed help.
changes.reason: 原英文仅不稳的步态，公交车突然晃动不是行走步态，另一句为弃人不顾的习语。

contexts.text: The bus gave a sudden lurch.
contexts.translation: 公交车突然猛晃了一下。

contexts.text: Don't leave me in the lurch.
contexts.translation: 别在我需要帮助时丢下我。

changes.before: money that is risked for possible monetary gain
changes.after: To risk money or something valuable on an uncertain outcome; also, a risky choice.
changes.reason: 原英文为下注的钱，两句是开店这一冒险行为及拿积蓄冒险的动词。

contexts.text: Opening a shop here is a gamble.
contexts.translation: 在这里开店是一场冒险。

contexts.text: I wouldn't gamble my savings on that idea.
contexts.translation: 我不会拿积蓄去赌那个想法。

changes.before: See Attar.
changes.reason: 原英文See Attar是香精油异体交叉引用，两句是普通人名；不提供泛人名多解题干，清空。

contexts.text: Otto is waiting at the entrance.
contexts.translation: 奥托正在入口等候。

contexts.text: Have you met my neighbour Otto?
contexts.translation: 你见过我的邻居奥托吗？

changes.before: an attendant who rocks a child in a cradle
changes.after: A rock-music performer, or a chair that moves gently backward and forward.
changes.reason: 原英文摇摇篮的照料者，两句为摇滚乐手和摇椅。

contexts.text: He used to be a rocker in a local band.
contexts.translation: 他以前是本地一支乐队的摇滚乐手。

contexts.text: Grandma sat in her favourite rocker.
contexts.translation: 奶奶坐在她最喜欢的摇椅上。

changes.before: a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system)
changes.after: To comfort someone who is upset; as a noun, a control panel or a device for video games.
changes.reason: 原英文限定科学监控仪器，两句是安慰和家用游戏机；改当前两个主要用法并兼顾控制台。

contexts.text: I tried to console her after the interview.
contexts.translation: 面试后我试着安慰她。

contexts.text: The game console is connected to the TV.
contexts.translation: 游戏机已经接到电视上了。

changes.before: a person who jumps
changes.after: A knitted garment worn over the upper body, especially in British English; also, someone who jumps.
changes.reason: 原英文跳跃者虽是真实次义，但两句均为英式套头毛衣，不应让所学服装义只对应一个人。

contexts.text: Bring a jumper in case it gets cold.
contexts.translation: 带件套头毛衣，以防天气变冷。

contexts.text: That jumper looks warm enough for winter.
contexts.translation: 那件套头毛衣看起来足够暖和，能过冬。

changes.before: Austrian architect and pioneer of modern architecture (1841-1918)
changes.reason: 原英文为奥地利建筑师，例1是作曲家音乐，例2是未确定身份的姓氏；不把两人强绑，退回中文题。

contexts.text: This concert features music by Wagner.
contexts.translation: 这场音乐会演奏瓦格纳的作品。

contexts.text: Mr Wagner called about the booking.
contexts.translation: 瓦格纳先生打电话询问了预订的事。

source.support: 完整官方词条明确Richard是德国作曲家，旧en奥地利建筑师为不同人；普通姓氏例不能强绑。

changes.before: happen simultaneously
changes.after: To agree with someone or reach the same conclusion.
changes.reason: 原英文同时发生，两句是同意判断和研究发现一致。

contexts.text: I concur with your assessment.
contexts.translation: 我同意你的判断。

contexts.text: The two reports concur on the main findings.
contexts.translation: 两份报告的主要发现一致。

changes.before: Scottish archaeologist (1890-1976)
changes.after: A vehicle with a specified number or type of wheels, usually named in a compound.
changes.reason: 原英文为苏格兰考古学家，与三轮车和未确定身份的女士姓氏均不匹配；官方词典支持复合词中的车辆义。

contexts.text: He rides a three-wheeler around the village.
contexts.translation: 他骑着三轮车在村子里转。

contexts.text: Ms Wheeler has the keys to the office.
contexts.translation: 惠勒女士拿着办公室的钥匙。

source.support: 完整词条明确in combination表示指定种类或数目的轮子的东西，示例three-wheeler；亦另有考古学家，不把姓名场景强绑该人。

changes.before: small wooden bat with a flat surface; used for hitting balls in various games
changes.after: A short, broad-bladed oar, or to move a boat through water using one.
changes.reason: 原英文体育球拍，两句是船桨及划船动词。

contexts.text: Can you pass me the paddle?
contexts.translation: 你能把桨递给我吗？

contexts.text: Let's paddle back before it gets dark.
contexts.translation: 我们趁天黑前划回去吧。

changes.before: n a state of extreme poverty
changes.after: The lack or loss of something necessary, such as sleep, food, or basic resources.
changes.reason: 原英文限定极端贫困，不能解释睡眠缺乏；改缺少或被剥夺必要资源的核心。

contexts.text: Sleep deprivation can make it hard to concentrate.
contexts.translation: 睡眠不足会让人难以集中注意力。

contexts.text: The report examines social deprivation in the area.
contexts.translation: 这份报告研究了当地社会资源匮乏的情况。

changes.before: pleasantly occupied
changes.after: Finding something funny or entertaining.
changes.reason: 原英文被愉快地占用，未表达觉得好笑，尤其例2否定是在表达一点不好笑。

contexts.text: She looked amused by my question.
contexts.translation: 她似乎觉得我的问题很好笑。

contexts.text: I wasn't amused when he hid my phone.
contexts.translation: 他把我的手机藏起来时，我可没觉得好笑。

changes.before: a sedimentary rock consisting mainly of calcium that was deposited by the remains of marine animals
changes.after: A sedimentary rock made mainly of calcium carbonate, often used in building.
changes.reason: 原英文把主要成分写成calcium而非calcium carbonate，并把成因限为海洋动物遗骸；按USGS纠正成分，不排除其他形成方式。

contexts.text: The walls are made of local limestone.
contexts.translation: 墙是用当地的石灰岩建成的。

contexts.text: We walked past a limestone cliff.
contexts.translation: 我们走过了一处石灰岩悬崖。

source.support: USGS官方地质资料确认主要是calcium carbonate；不是金属元素钙。

changes.before: a member of a Buddhist people living in Myanmar and adjacent parts of Thailand
changes.after: The written abbreviation for Monday.
changes.reason: 原英文为缅甸泰国的孟族成员，当前zh及两句都明确是星期一书面缩写。

contexts.text: The sign says the shop is closed on Mon.
contexts.translation: 牌子上写着商店星期一休息。

contexts.text: Our timetable labels Monday as Mon.
contexts.translation: 我们的课表把星期一缩写为Mon.。

source.support: 官方搜索词条确认Monday书面缩写，直接打开失败不当作额外证据。

changes.before: (psychiatry) an abnormal absorption with the self; marked by communication disorders and short attention span and inability to treat others as people
changes.after: A developmental condition involving social communication differences and restricted or repetitive behaviors.
changes.reason: 原英文自我沉溺、不能把别人当人等旧述错误且误导；按CDC的发育与社交行为差异重述，仅术语辨识。

contexts.text: The school offers support for children with autism.
contexts.translation: 学校为自闭症儿童提供支持。

contexts.text: We attended a talk about autism.
contexts.translation: 我们听了一场关于自闭症的讲座。

source.support: CDC完整正文说明发育差异、社交交流和行为模式差异，个体能力差别大；原旧述不能当作现代通用定义。

changes.before: draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible
changes.after: To write, carve, or engrave words on a surface.
changes.reason: 原英文化为在图形内作内接图形，两句是奖杯和戒指上刻字。

contexts.text: Please inscribe her name on the trophy.
contexts.translation: 请把她的名字刻在奖杯上。

contexts.text: They will inscribe a short message inside the ring.
contexts.translation: 他们会在戒指内侧刻上一句短短的话。

changes.before: n invests in a theatrical production
changes.after: A person who supports an idea or project, often by providing money.
changes.reason: 原英文仅剧场制作投资者，两句为一般项目资金支持者及理念支持者，未给剧场身份。

contexts.text: The project needs a financial backer.
contexts.translation: 这个项目需要一个资金支持者。

contexts.text: She was an early backer of the idea.
contexts.translation: 她很早就支持这个想法了。
